LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.label: The Final Battle
LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.description: The Partisans have assembled all local elite forces to launch a final battle against the colony. Every four hours, attacks of varying intensity will be launched based on the colony's status. To achieve victory in this war, you must either break their morale, or annihilate their entire force.
LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.endMessage: The Final Battle has come to an end...
LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.letterText: The Ratkin Underground Partisans has launched their final battle! They will continue to attack your colony.
